# Revlet Platform (app.revlet.me)

> Professional business email, simple DNS management, and secure team access — all in one place.

Revlet helps growing businesses, schools, and teams run their cloud infrastructure from one simple, secure dashboard. Launch custom `@yourdomain.com` email accounts, manage your domain DNS with restore points, and invite teammates with the exact access they need for each organization.

## What You Can Do with Revlet
- **Business Email on Your Own Domain**: Create `@yourcompany.com` mailboxes, aliases, mailing groups, and organizational units in minutes. Built-in SPF, DKIM, and DMARC protection helps your emails reach the inbox, while a 14-day recovery window protects against accidental deletion.
- **Simple, Reliable DNS Management**: Add, search, and update domain records (`A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `SRV`, `NS`) from a clean interface, and save restore points before making major changes.
- **Per-Organization Team Access**: Invite teammates as organization admins or grant access only to specific services (DNS or Email) per organization—without ever sharing root passwords or provider keys.
- **Multi-Organization Workspace**: Manage multiple companies, brands, or client domains from a single Revlet account and switch between them in one click.
